_comment: Baseline of known zero-reference names as of Skin 2026.10.3.122 (2026-10-28). Cleanup batch 3 deleted 9 manually-reviewed names (4 includes, 5 variables) plus 22 cascade definitions (bgTimePerImage1-20, fuse3info1, Path_Youtube_Query) whose only uses were inside deleted definitions. 122 fixes the poster-wall unwatched badge by passing the raw boolean expression to the unwatched param instead of $VAR (Kodi does not expand $VAR produced by $PARAM substitution); that removed variable definition YoPlayerBrowseUnwatchedFlag, so defined variables went 431->430 and uses 2523->2519 with no change to the dead counts. The 71 skinshortcuts includes were deleted together with their file (script-skinshortcuts-includes.xml, an import leftover from 780e5fd that was never referenced or loaded by the skin); dead includes are now 0. Remaining dead variables are theme definitions (38) and dynamic $PARAM-suffixed detail variables (10).
